onboarding.title: New User Guide
onboarding.subtitle: Discover the main features of E-Wallet Kita to manage family finances smartly
onboarding.welcome_desc: Hello! We are thrilled to have you here. Let's take a quick 1-minute tour to understand the core features of this application for seamless financial management.
onboarding.welcome_point_1: ✍️ Manual Entry — Fast and precise transaction logging
onboarding.welcome_point_2: 📅 Transaction History — Monitor ledger & export beautiful PDF reports
onboarding.welcome_point_3: 🤖 Telegram AI Assistant — Quick auto-log via texting or receipt photos
onboarding.catat_desc: This feature allows you to record your daily income or expenses manually with speed and precision.
onboarding.catat_practice_success: Awesome! Your simulated transaction has been saved in temporary memory. That is how simple it is!
onboarding.history_desc: All recorded cash flows are structured here. You can track, search, edit, or delete them anytime.
onboarding.history_feature_1: 🔍 Quick Search: Find transactions by description or notes.
onboarding.history_feature_2: 📅 Precise Filter: Filter by specific months or categories easily.
onboarding.history_feature_3: 📄 PDF Export: Download formal reports of your family wealth statements.
onboarding.history_practice_desc: Click the category tabs below to see how the ledger updates dynamically!
onboarding.concl_desc: You are now ready to take control of your financial destiny. Start logging your transactions today for a healthier and smarter family budget.
onboarding.concl_tip: Premium Tip: Connect the Telegram Bot in Settings to log transactions automatically by texting or uploading receipts!
onboarding.dashboard_banner_desc: We have prepared a quick interactive guide (1 minute) to introduce the Manual Entry and Transaction History features.
onboarding.budget_desc: Set monthly spending limits for each category to keep your finances in check.
onboarding.budget_feature_1: ⚠️ Auto-Alerts: Get notified if spending approaches your limit.
onboarding.budget_feature_2: 📊 Realization Monitor: View the percentage of budget used for each category.
onboarding.bill_desc: Track your recurring bills so you never miss a payment.
onboarding.bill_feature_1: 🔔 Timely Notifications: Get reminders via Telegram before they are due.
onboarding.bill_feature_2: 💳 Mark as Paid: Record bill payments with a single click.
onboarding.telegram_desc: No need to open the app — chat, send a voice note, or snap a receipt photo to the bot and it's logged automatically.
onboarding.telegram_feature_1: 💬 Text chats & voice notes are auto-converted into fully categorized transactions.
onboarding.telegram_feature_2: 📸 Receipt photos are scanned automatically (OCR) — no manual typing needed.
onboarding.telegram_setup_hint: You can connect the Telegram bot anytime from the Settings menu after this guide.
onboarding.wallet_desc: Separate your E-Wallet, Bank Account, and Cash balances — all summarized neatly in one view.
onboarding.wallet_feature_1: 💰 Each wallet's balance is tracked separately, with the total auto-calculated.
onboarding.wallet_feature_2: 🎯 Pick a specific wallet when logging a transaction for better accuracy.
onboarding.savings_desc: Set money aside into goal-based pockets. It's still counted as your wealth, and can be withdrawn anytime.
onboarding.savings_feature_1: 🎯 Create a pocket for a specific goal, like an Emergency Fund or Vacation.
onboarding.savings_feature_2: 🔄 Deposit & withdraw anytime, with clear progress tracking.
onboarding.gold_desc: Buy physical gold (Antam, UBS, Galeri 24, etc.) or log gold you already own. Its value follows the current market price.
onboarding.gold_feature_1: 📈 Real-time gold prices from trusted sources, synced automatically.
onboarding.gold_feature_2: 💹 Profit/loss auto-calculated from the difference between buy price and current price.
onboarding.installments_desc: Track your progress paying off a motorcycle loan, mortgage, or other long-term debt.
onboarding.installments_feature_1: 📊 Clear repayment progress for every installment.
onboarding.installments_feature_2: 🔔 Automatic reminders before each monthly due date.
